Heirospecter is a dark, ghostly Hecto-Titan whose unearthly body bears gold-trimmed armor with a red gem at its center.

== History ==
The Sand Snakes can restore Heirospecter by reciting a spell in an ancient language. [LGS-046]

== Abilities ==
Using its 'Everlive' ability, Heirospecter can allow itself and its allies to recover from battle.

== History ==
The [[Sand Snake]]s can restore Heirospecter by reciting a spell in an ancient language. {{Source|LGS-046}}

== Abilities ==
Using its 'Everlive' ability, Heirospecter can allow itself and its allies to recover from battle.
